name: The Mandela Experience
source:
Mark gets an unexpected call from his friend, Cesar. Cesar's mom fainted and he doesn't know what happened. While he's on his way to the ER, he calls Mark to help him with turning on some cameras in his house, as he doesn't feel right with leaving his home empty and doesn't want to risk it getting it robbed again.

[From [url=https://shattered-eye-games.itch.io/the-mandela-experience]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Mark突然接到朋友Cesar打来的电话。Cesar的母亲昏倒了，他不知道发生了什么。前往急诊室的路上，他打电话请Mark帮忙开启家里的监控摄像头，因为他不放心把家里空着，也不想冒险让房子再次遭窃。

[来源：[url=https://shattered-eye-games.itch.io/the-mandela-experience]Itch.io[/url]]
